name: tma_store_loaded
question: Full-gpu persistent GEMMs simulate 0.48-0.69 of the hardware time (bw CUF-DSL-DENSE-PERSIST-C04 0.637, PREFETCH-C04 0.581, BS-NVF4 0.554, DGF-KG 0.478, FIF-BS 0.602; hp cutlass tma_ws 0.82) while one-tile-per-CTA kernels of the same code (bw CUF-DSL-DENSE-F16-C02 0.897) and single-cluster captures (0.86-1.06) are close. Evidence taken before this protocol (measured, $A/fg-fix5/r1/pc-CUF-DSL-DENSE-PERSIST-C04.txt = ncu --source-stalls vs the sim journal, both normalised to total warp time; sim journal of CTA 42 in ~/tmp/fg-gemm/c04-cta42-warps.txt): PERSIST-C04 has 11.4 tiles per CTA, 4 epilogue sub-tiles of 8 KiB per tile; HW 2490 cycles per tile (tensor pipe 41 % busy = 1024 / 2490), sim 1147. The whole HW - sim warp-time gap (91.6 k warp-cycles per CTA) sits on epilogue PCs: 'barrier' samples after the second BAR.SYNC of each sub-tile (the 3 non-elected warps waiting for the elected warp's UTMASTG / UTMACMDFLUSH / DEPBAR.LE SB0,3 path: HW 45.2 k vs sim 11 k), long_sb at FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S (22.1 k vs 2.5 k), long_sb at the BAR.SYNCs (24.2 k vs ~4 k), short_sb at the first F2FP after LDTM (10.8 k vs 2.7 k); mbarrier waits are equal in absolute warp-cycles (48.7 k vs 49.6 k). In the sim the tile period is set by three installed limits that coincide (UMMA 1024 / tile, per-SM L2 read port 128 KiB / 124.6 = 1052, aggregate l2_write_bytes_per_ns 8038 B/ns / 148 SMs = 28.6 B/cycle per SM against 32 KiB per tile = 1146), i.e. the sim epilogue ring drains 8 KiB per ~287 cycles while HW issues one sub-tile per ~550-620 cycles (12.2 B/cycle per SM, 2.8 TB/s aggregate). Which part of the store-epilogue round is longer on hardware than the installed leaves say: (a) the per-SM drain of ring-pipelined TMA stores, (b) its coupling to TMA tile loads in flight on the same SM, (c) the aggregate drain when all SMs store at once, (d) the coupling of (b) under full load, or (e) the local steps (smem write + async-proxy fence, named barrier, UTMASTG issue)?
probe: tools/microbench/tma_store_loaded/probe/tma_store_loaded.cu: grid N CTAs, one per SM (135 KB dynamic smem), 256 threads. Warps 0-3 (128 threads, named barrier 1) run the epilogue ring: per round every thread writes 64 B with 4 st.shared.v4 into stage buffer r % D (8 KiB box), fence.proxy.async.shared::cta, bar.sync 1,128; thread 0 issues one UTMASTG (2d tile, 256 B x 32 rows, no swizzle), cp.async.bulk.commit_group, cp.async.bulk.wait_group.read <D-1>; bar.sync 1,128 (the instruction sequence of the CUTLASS sm90 / sm100 TMA epilogue minus the accumulator read). kind stg replaces the round by 4 st.global.v4 per thread onto the same destination rows (8 KiB per round, no fence / barrier / TMA). Warps 4-7 lane 0 (L = 4): one 16 KiB SWIZZLE_128B UTMALDG slot each over a 24 MiB L2-resident tensor, mbarrier.test_wait spin, re-issue (the tma_loaded v2 loader: one warp per in-flight box, no try_wait), until thread 0 raises the stop flag (epilogue on) or for 256 boxes per warp (epilogue off). Destination: each CTA owns region_boxes consecutive boxes; ring = 4 boxes rewritten, fresh = every round a new box (rounds 72: 148 x 72 x 8 KiB = 85 MiB); state warm = cudaMemset of the destination before each launch, cold = 512 MiB scratch memset before each launch (L2 evicted; the load tensor is re-written afterwards so loads stay L2 hits). All CTAs meet on a global arrival counter; the first 8 rounds are not counted; 8 repetitions after a discarded launch; two runs (a, b) in one job. STAMPS 0: no clock read inside the round, period = counted window / counted rounds per CTA. STAMPS 1: clock64 after each step, per-round means of thread 0 (fence = 4 STS + fence, bar1, issue = UTMASTG + commit, wait = wait_group, bar2) and thread 32 (fence, bar1, rest = bar1 exit to bar2 exit), pooled per-round wait and round times.
cells: run.sh. Controls: tma N1 L0 D1 ring (s1, s0), tma NMAX L0 D1 ring s0, loader-only (epi 0) L4 at N in {1,16,64,NMAX}. Main: N in {1,16,64,NMAX} x L in {0,4}: tma D4 ring s0/s1, tma D4 fresh warm s0/s1, tma D4 fresh cold s0, stg ring s0, stg fresh warm s0.
sass_gate: sass_check.py on the cuobjdump of the built binary (run by build.sh; failure stops the run): 8 k_epilogue instantiations; tma kernels hold per round body 4 STS .128, 1 MEMBAR, 1 FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC, 2 BAR.SYNC 0x1,0x80, 1 UTMASTG, 1 UTMACMDFLUSH, 1 DEPBAR.LE SB0 with immediate D-1, no STG .128; stg kernels 4 STG .128 and none of the others; one common integer body-duplication factor allowed. If the fence PTX does not lower to MEMBAR + FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S (the pair in the GEMM SASS at 0x2260/0x2270) the gate is corrected to the lowered form before any timed run and the difference is recorded.
derivation: model.py. P(kind,N,L,D,dst,state) = median over CTAs x repetitions x runs of the per-CTA period (cycles per round, STAMPS 0); A = aggregate store B/ns (sum of counted bytes / span of the globaltimer windows); R_load = loader bytes / cycle per CTA; cpn = clock64 cycles per globaltimer ns from the same windows. Installed-leaf prediction of the saturated ring: P_pred(N) = 8192 / min(store_l2.sector_bytes_per_cycle, l2_write_bytes_per_ns / (N x cpn)) (b300 254.5 at N = 1, ~287 at N = 148; h100 258.8 at N = 1, ~535 at N = 132). O1 rho1 = P(tma,1,0,4,ring) / P_pred(1). O2 kappa = P(tma,1,4,4) / P(tma,1,0,4), lambda = R_load(tma,1,4,4) / R_load(loader-only N1), U = 1 / kappa + lambda. O3 rho_N = P(tma,NMAX,0,4) / P_pred(NMAX) for ring and fresh warm, with A_tma and A_stg at NMAX. O4 kappa_N = P(tma,NMAX,4,4) / P(tma,NMAX,0,4), lambda_N = R_load(tma,NMAX,4,4) / R_load(loader-only NMAX). O5 per-step means at N1 L0 D4 ring. Analog = P(tma,NMAX,4,4,fresh,warm).
acceptance: Controls first, nothing else is read if one fails: (C1) N1 L0 D1 ring s1: seg_issue + seg_wait (UTMASTG issue to wait_group 0 return) within 20 % of the installed storage.tma.completion UTMASTG tile value at 8192 B (b300 275, h100 322); (C2) loader-only N1 L4: R_load within 15 % of tma_loaded N1.S4 of the device (b300 92.7, h100 88.9 B/cycle; $A/microbench/tma_loaded/{b300-r2,h100-r2}). Per cell: (P90 - P10) / median of per-CTA periods < 10 % for N >= 16, runs a / b within 5 %; a cell failing these is reported and not used. STAMPS 1 cells are used for step attribution only when P(s1) / P(s0) <= 1.15 for that cell.

engine_rules_declared_before_data.O1_per_sm_bulk_store_drain: if rho1 > 1.15 (ring and fresh warm agree within 10 %): cluster-local field store_l2.bulk_sector_bytes_per_cycle = 8192 / P(tma,1,0,4,ring); MemoryHierarchy::store charges bulk (TMA) store sectors on the per-SM store port at that rate instead of store_l2.sector_bytes_per_cycle (same port, different occupancy). rho1 within 0.85-1.15: nothing. rho1 < 0.85: recorded (the ring is not port-saturated), nothing installed.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.O2_same_sm_bulk_sharing: if kappa > 1.15 or lambda < 0.85: TMA loads and TMA stores of one SM share one bulk-transfer server. Accepted only if 0.85 <= U <= 1.15 (time sharing): engine rule, no new leaf value: bulk load sectors and bulk store sectors of one SM additionally serialise on one per-SM server, each occupying it sector_bytes / (the installed per-SM port rate of its direction). Otherwise recorded, rule form goes to an addendum before any further data.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.O3_aggregate_bulk_store_drain: control: where the stg cells saturate at NMAX (P_stg(NMAX) >= 1.15 x P_stg(1)) A_stg(NMAX) must be within 15 % of the installed l2_write_bytes_per_ns, else the aggregate comparison is not made. If A_tma(NMAX,0,4) < 0.85 x min(l2_write_bytes_per_ns, NMAX x cpn x 8192 / P(tma,1,0,4)) on ring and fresh warm (the two within 10 %): gpu-shared field memory.shared_service l2_bulk_write_bytes_per_ns = A_tma(NMAX,0,4,fresh warm); bulk store sectors pass the shared L2 write service at that rate instead of l2_write_bytes_per_ns (same queue, different occupancy per sector). If fresh cold differs from fresh warm by more than 15 % the L2 residency of the destination matters: recorded only (which state a captured launch is in is not a captured fact).
engine_rules_declared_before_data.O4_full_load_coupling: if kappa_N > 1.15 x max(kappa, 1) or lambda_N < 0.85 x min(lambda, 1): L2 reads and writes share one aggregate budget under full load: gpu-shared field memory.shared_service l2_combined_bytes_per_ns = A_store + A_load at (NMAX, L4, D4) if ring and fresh warm agree within 10 %; engine: L2 read and write shared services additionally draw on one combined queue (the structure dram_combined_bytes_per_ns already has). Otherwise nothing.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.O5_local_steps: installed expectation at N1 L0: fence step (4 STS + MEMBAR.ALL.CTA + FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S) <= 45 cycles, bar1 and bar2 exits = synchronization.cta.release 16 + arrival skew, issue step (UTMASTG + UTMACMDFLUSH) <= 10. A step exceeding its expectation by more than 30 cycles at N1 L0 on both runs is a cluster-local leaf gap; this protocol only records it (value, dependence on L and N); the owning leaf is re-measured under its own protocol (service_latency / barrier_release addendum) before any install.
engine_rules_declared_before_data.reproduction: the GEMM analog cell is (tma, NMAX, L4, D4, fresh warm). HW PERSIST-C04 issues one sub-tile per 550-620 cycles. If the analog period on b300 is below 400 the probe does not contain the ingredient that stretches the GEMM epilogue (candidates not in this probe: UTCHMMA running on the same SM, LDTM of the accumulator, the mbarrier hand-offs); then nothing GEMM-directed is installed from this version and the next cell set (UMMA / LDTM on the same CTA) is declared in an addendum before it is run.

install: only through a rule above whose condition holds, with evidence measured when the cell's runs agree within 5 % and its spread is < 10 %, experimental when runs agree within 10 %; source tma_store_loaded.<device>.<run> (artifact $A/microbench/tma_store_loaded/<device>-<run>/, model $A/fg-gemm/tsl/<device>-model.json). Gate after any install: full-gpu 500 x 2 against $A/fg-fix5/full-r7 and single-cluster 500 x 2 against $A/fg-fix5/sc-r7 (sc MAPE must not get worse), CTest, pytest, cyclescope tree validate --strict.
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold, derivation or rule change after data; a leaf of one device is not copied to the other.

addenda.before_run: r2 (after the r1 build stopped at the SASS gate on both devices, exit 3, no timed cell run, no jsonl)
addenda.text: SASS gate count correction only: every kernel holds one FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S in its prologue (fence.mbarrier_init.release.cluster of the loader mbarriers lowers to it), outside the round loop; the gate counted it as a round fence (found k + 1, wanted k). The round body lowers exactly as declared (4 STS.128, MEMBAR.ALL.CTA, FENCE.VIEW.ASYNC.S, 2 BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING 0x1,0x80, UTMASTG.2D, UTMACMDFLUSH, DEPBAR.LE SB0,D-1; ptxas duplicates the body k = 3 or 5 times) and the stg kernels hold 4 k STG.E.128 and no MEMBAR / round fence. sass_check.py now subtracts the one prologue fence and additionally requires 0 round fences / MEMBARs in the stg kernels. Probe, cells, derivation and rules unchanged. Excerpts: ~/tmp/fg-gemm/sass-gate-lines-{b300,h100}-r1.txt.

Both controls failed on both devices, so no rule of this version is evaluated and nothing is installed. C1: UTMASTG issue to wait_group 0 return 492 (b300) / 493 (h100) cycles against the installed 275 / 322: the probe's store map (256 B rows x 32, no swizzle, L2 promotion none) is not the map the leaf was measured with (tma_forms: 128 B rows x 64, SWIZZLE_128B, L2 promotion 128B), and the captured GEMM store maps are a third geometry (bw CUF-DSL: 64 B rows x 128, SWIZZLE_64B, promotion 128B, global row stride 10496 B). C2: loader-only 58.5 / 68.5 B/cycle against 92.7 / 88.9: the load tensor was rewritten by cudaMemset before every launch and each CTA walked a 24 MiB / N region, so the N = 1 loads were not L2 read hits. Recorded facts (not used for any install): the full round period is the same at N = 1, 16, 64 and all SMs with no loads in flight (b300 575, h100 580-602 cycles per 8 KiB round), i.e. the stretch is inside one SM; wait_group<3> returns in 5 cycles (the 4-stage ring never fills), the round is the sum of the fence step (thread 0 ~200-234), barrier 1 (~100-150), UTMASTG + commit (~207-221) and barrier 2 (37); with wait_group<0> the wait adds ~285; with 4 loaders the fence step grows to 360-510 and the round to 820-920 (N = 1). The two stamped threads disagree by ~205 cycles on when barrier 1 is left, which the two-thread stamps cannot resolve. stg cells: b300 N = 1 511 cycles per round (512 half-written sectors), h100 N = 1 760, h100 N = 132 1650-1800 (aggregate 1.06-1.12 kB/ns of written bytes). Superseded by protocol-v2.json.
